selection_rule: Use the sustained 2026-2030 mean predicted LST rather than a single endpoint or maximum year.
Use continuous relative heat-percentile Sen slope for spatial urgency within Kaduwela. Do not assign an arbitrary ordinal score to the descriptive trajectory classes.
Use mean 2026-2030 (1 - green_mask): directly interpretable as persistent green-cover deficit and aligned with Step 29A.
Use mean 2026-2030 NDBI: direct built-up intensity measure and the same intervention dimension manipulated in Step 29B.
Use distance-to-water as direct spatial accessibility/proximity deficit. NDWI remains wetness evidence and is not interpreted as literal water-cover percentage.
Use mean 2026-2030 cooling benefit from Step 29C's already-frozen PRIMARY scenario: +10pp green with MODERATE built-up reduction.
